programmes.t: The Demolition Man S1 - "Lewisham"
programmes.d: A council flat in Lewisham must come down quickly and without harming the local residents’ flats situated only metres away.

programmes.t: The Demolition Man S1 - "Paris"
programmes.d: Two high-rises in Meaux have to be demolished without endangering the surrounding people and buildings.

programmes.t: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programmes.d: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programmes.t: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programmes.d: In this exciting episode we’ll find out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how we can prevent them. Cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send our hosts, our stunt team and our special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

programmes.t: Survival Science S1 - "Sniper Attack"
programmes.d: Military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition. Bottom line, a ton of cool shooting and science for Nick and Laura to explore!

programmes.t: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Lightning Strike"
programmes.d: Laura and Nick travel to a state-of-the-art Direct Effects Lightning Test Lab. With some “explosive” experiments, they’ll determine the power lightning and how it behaves?  And they’ll find out how can hunters and fishermen best protect themselves?

programmes.t: Engineering the Future S1 - "Fusion"
programmes.d: It is the greatest technological challenge ever undertaken by humankind. The quest to produce the ultimate energy solution... fusion.

programmes.t: Engineering the Future S1 - "Tidal"
programmes.d: The power of the ocean's tides is the last great untapped energy source on Earth. Teams of engineers race to perfect the technology to harness the vast flowers of water.

programmes.t: Engineering the Future S1 - "Maritime"
programmes.d: Shipping companies and engineers are creating new machines to make their industry greener using a resource that has moved man across oceans for thousands of years... winds.

programmes.t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Tate Modern, TWA Hotel, Tropical Island Resort"
programmes.d: A power station, airport terminal, and airship hangar undergo dramatic structural revamps into world-class facilities.

programmes.t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre"
programmes.d: A historic train station, grain silos, and broadcasting headquarters are transformed into state-of-the-art hubs.

programmes.t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Maritime Museum, Coal Drops Yard, Peace Bunker"
programmes.d: A dry dock, coal depot, and Cold War tank shelter are reimagined into striking contemporary public spaces.

programmes.t: Building to the Sky S1 - "Monuments and Money 1972 - 1997"
programmes.d: Engineering breakthroughs like bundled-tube systems support massive towers until financial shifts push high-rise development toward Asia.

programmes.t: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "FLORIDA"
programmes.d: Florida wasn’t always the Sunshine State. In the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a vacation destination, sparking a land boom–and bust–the likes of which America had never seen before.

programmes.t: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "MAUVE"
programmes.d: In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue -- the world’s first synthetic dye. In just a few years, ‘Mauve’ would take over the fashion industry and enable stunning advances in medicine.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Space Myths"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli speaks to two experts who debunk many of the myths about outer space.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Lost in Space"
programmes.d: There have been a few occasions when spacecraft have been lost in space. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at several of these adventures.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Canadian Space Agency"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Canadian Space Center in Quebec, and examines their exceptional expertise in robotics, which includes the famous Canadarm.

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "MacSchappert"
programmes.d: What can Terry do with just a paperclip? Probably nothing, but Larry and Terry will test several scenes from MacGyver, including making an exploding pen, shooting a spear out of a telescope, and they will enlist the help of Andre Ellingson’s Special Effects team to see if they can turn a car muffler

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S5 - "Terry's Lethal Weapon"
programmes.d: Can a Surfboard act as a projectile going through a car windshield and killing the bad guy?Can a 9mm bullet go through a bulldozer bucket to stop the driver?And will a AK47 be able to fire under water?

programmes.t: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S5 - "Jean Claude Van Schappert"
programmes.d: Terry enters the world of Slow-Mo and explosions trying to imitate Jean Claude in Hart Target. Terry and Larry will be testing 5 scenes from the Hard Target films. One of which will make you never look through a peep hole again!

programmes.t: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Food"
programmes.d: Large factory farms produce food for the masses with one caveat; they’re terrible for the environment. In an attempt to remedy this, chefs and scientists are working together to create a future where what we eat is as sustainable as it is delicious.

programmes.t: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "Hot Zones"
programmes.d: Examines how recent trends in globalization and the altering of ecosystems have led to dramatic increases in the spread of infectious diseases.

programmes.t: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "Seas of Grass"
programmes.d: Shows the devastating environmental, political, and economic effects of the degradation of the world's grasslands.

programmes.t: Journey to Planet Earth S2 - "On the Brink"
programmes.d: Considers how environmental pressures can lead to terrorism and regional conflict.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Time"
programmes.d: Jack meets a woman who has lost all sense of time and reveals how time can be elastic.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "The Senses"
programmes.d: Jack meets people with synaesthesia and experiences multisensory gastronomy.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Pain & Fear"
programmes.d: Wim Hof teaches Jack how to control his pain and plunge into the ice cold sea.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Creativity"
programmes.d: Jack meets a man with Sudden Artistic Output syndrome and unleashes his creativity.

programmes.t: Extremes S1 - "Largest Animals, Human Bodies and Football"
programmes.d: In this episode of Extremes, we will be exploring the largest animals, extreme facts about the human body and record breaking extremes in football and the field of music.

programmes.t: Power & S3 - "MMA - Nick Hein"
programmes.d: Nick Hein is a professional Mixed Martial Artist from Cologne and signed with the UFC. His ultimate goal is to become MMA world champion.

programmes.t: Power & S3 - "Extreme Martial Arts – Shaina West"
programmes.d: Shaina West taught herself martial arts by watching Youtube recovering from a motorcycle accident. The videos she posted went viral and ‘The Samurider’ was born.

programmes.t: Power & S3 - "Karate – James Pankiewicz"
programmes.d: Englishman and karateka James Pankiewicz came to Okinawa, the birthplace of Karate, for his wife and to open a Dojo and the immensely popular Dojo Bar.

programmes.t: Power & S3 - "Bokator – Tharot Sam"
programmes.d: Tharoth Sam, 26, is the first female fighter in Cambodian Bokator. She is also an MMA fighter and became a movie star starring in the big screen blockbuster, Jailbreak.

programmes.t: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona"
programmes.d: Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.

programmes.t: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"
programmes.d: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.
